description: One model in the ORDERED chain a host falls back through: the model's identity plus the name the reader should see. The record is a VALUE and the chain is an ordered list of these, so a reorder is a new list rather than a mutation. It deliberately carries no score, price or capability: a chain is a sequence of choices, and the facts that drive the choice live in the host's AiModelInfo catalogue.

members.name: FromModel
members.description: Builds an entry from a catalogue model, so a host that offers AvailableModels can add one to its chain without copying the identity by hand.

members.name: DisplayName
members.description: The name a surface prints: Label when the host supplied one, else ModelId.

members.name: HasLabel
members.description: Whether the host supplied a label for the model.

members.name: Label
members.description: The model as the reader should see it. Empty falls back to ModelId.

members.name: ModelId
members.description: Stable identity of the model in the chain. Never empty: a missing id is generated at construction.
